name: qa-l10-mega-pursuit
note: E32-AC10 (L10-S3): the Mega Alpha's persistent pursuit, followed by the game camera. The courier runs a loop through an R3-style yard (container stacks, garden walls); the Mega has no sight of her and steers round the obstacles at 0.7x her run speed, never through them. Look for: feet on the ground, facing along its travel, no sliding sideways, no cutting through containers or walls, no popping/teleport, the gap to the courier growing while she runs. metrics.megaAlpha: detailedMedianMs vs cruiseMs, stepMaxM, modes, distance samples.
